first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports simplification for SMB/self-serve accounts. Verify the durable signup lift and the complex-workspace churn caveat before testing. Run a guarded, segmented experiment that simplifies onboarding for lower-complexity self-serve accounts while retaining the full flow for complex workspaces; evaluate qualified revenue and retention, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and simple self-serve accounts, where prior source records show higher activation, completion, time-to-value, and qualified revenue. Exclude complex-workspace accounts and retain their full setup flow because shortened onboarding increased 60-day churn by 9% there. Monitor activation, completion, qualified revenue, and 30-/60-day retention before expanding.
